lists.name: RYM Top — Regional Music — Southern Gospel

podcast.body: This was Elvis's first full-length gospel record and is considered "probably the purest expression of Elvis's own musical instincts yet," as he had always wanted to be a singer in a gospel quartet. He sang gospel songs with the Jordanaires exactly as he wanted to, but the album only made number 13 on the charts. "His handyman was probably the purest expression of Elvis's own musical instincts yet."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 82: "Are You Lonesome Tonight?" by Elvis Presley
